intro: Send the screenshot and I'll try to fill it in for you. AI helps, but you're in charge.

errors.fileType: Use a PNG, JPG or WEBP image.
errors.fileSize: Image too large. Try one smaller than 8 MB.
errors.ocrFallback: I couldn't read everything from this image.
errors.network: Couldn't connect right now. Try again in a moment.

success.title: Done, expense saved!
success.subtitle: I've added this expense to your history.

analyzing.title: Reading your receipt...
analyzing.subtitle: Looking for amount, date and description. You'll review everything before saving.

review.subOne: Check if it's right before saving.
review.tip: Take a look and save whenever you're ready.
review.itemsHint: Items are auxiliary info only. The purchase is saved as a single expense.

guard: To add expenses, choose an active plan.

dup.desc: This expense seems to be already registered. Save anyway?

qr.notFiscal: This QR code wasn't recognized as a supported invoice. We'll read the image instead.
qr.fallbackOcr: I couldn't use this invoice's official data right now. I'll read the image instead.
qr.privacy: Nothing is saved before you confirm.

dupPreview.title: Possible duplicate
